13059.notes: Georgia redeemable tax-deed county in consolidated Athens-Clarke County. Tax Commissioner is ex-officio sheriff for tax sales. Official rules: sales begin 10:00 a.m. first Tuesday of the month in front of the courthouse; public outcry; opening bid = taxes due plus costs; may continue next day at 10:00 a.m. if parcels remain after 4:00 p.m. Payment by cashier’s or certified check (FDIC/FSLIC insured). Tax deed recorded and mailed to purchaser. Advertised four consecutive weeks in legal notices (Athens Banner-Herald).

01103.notes: Alabama tax-lien county.
